target_customer: Consumer gamers and creators who play and publish alternate history scenarios; revenue from paid daily tokens and a subscription
problem: Grand strategy games are limited to pre-designed scenarios. Players want to play any what-if history and have non-player countries react intelligently.
business_model: Consumer freemium: one free daily token, extra sessions at $1 per token, and a Pax Patron subscription (per StartupHub review)
product_category: AI-powered map-based sandbox and grand strategy game

founders.name: Eli Bullock-Papa
founders.background_notes: YC page bio only says co-founder of Pax Historia.

founders.name: Ryan Zhang
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as Founder/CTO; bio says only that he likes history.

competitors.name: Rewrite History: War Room
competitors.what: AI game generating narratives for each decision in alternate history scenarios

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs an LLM-driven simulation of non-player actors on a map with user-generated scenario tooling. Standard engineering on third-party model APIs, with the hard part being coherent, affordable AI turns.

defensibility.rationale: The YC launch post reports 35k daily users and over 4k published presets (self-reported), a user-generated content library that gives some lock-in. The AI layer itself relies on model-provider APIs and is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent response found as of the sources reviewed.

market_need_then: Organic demand shown by tens of thousands of daily players after an August 2025 alpha launch, per the company and YC launch post (self-reported). Generative AI made open-ended scenario play feasible.

identity.voice_and_tone: plain, playful what-if framing in the YC description (What if Rome never fell?)

branding.brand_signature: What-if framing of alternate history scenarios
branding.community_and_virality: Company claims an organically built fanbase of tens of thousands of daily players (YC page, self-reported). No independent press about the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: Little independent coverage found; the name is Latin and fits the subject, but no source shows the brand driving growth.

outcome_analysis: Pax Historia is an active Winter 2026 company with no exit. It grew organically after an August 2025 alpha to a reported 35k daily users before the batch, which points to early product-market fit helped by cheap generative AI. No verified funding round or later outcome exists yet, so its trajectory is unknown.
notes: Unverified funding: one aggregator (VCBacked) lists $500K pre-seed in March 2026 with YC as investor, and Simplify lists $130K; neither is confirmed by a primary source, so no round is recorded. StartupHub says founded 2022 while the YC page says 2025; YC page used. Outcome search found nothing about the company. Website fetch returned only a one-line landing page. No Epoch Alternate History competitor listed because its AI use is disputed.
